english.toefl: Full: 5.0 new scale or 103 old; limited: 4.0 new or 79 old
english.note: IELTS 6.5 / Duolingo 115 can meet limited-status minimum. New-scale scores after January 20, 2026; old before January 21. TOEFL Essentials/MyBest and IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted. Exemptions include degree, two years study, or two years work in U.S./approved country within five years. Biophysics lists TOEFL speaking 24; 20–23 may be considered after phone interview. Own old full-status threshold (<102) conflicts with central 103; central higher retained. Program names TOEFL/IELTS only.

applicationFee.note: Domestic and international $90 under current central policy. Domestic waivers for eligible categories; international waiver only under approved valid exchange agreement. Program pages generally exclude international waivers. Biophysics still quotes domestic $70; current central $90 retained. Central exchange-agreement exception means waiver availability is not exclusively domestic; international applicants should confirm approved agreement with Graduate College.

documents: Uploaded official transcript copies and grade legend
International applicants: passport and English test if required
requirements.note: GPA guideline 3.0 for final two undergraduate years; report home institution grading scale, do not convert. Declaration/Certification of Finance not required because incoming students' support guaranteed.

funding.note: Incoming support guaranteed. Continued support while in good standing and satisfactory progress contingent on funds. Center funds first semester; research advisor typically thereafter; tuition/fee waivers and assistantships/fellowships. One semester teaching required.

timeline.interviews: Contiguous-U.S. residents may interview on campus; applicants outside U.S. contacted for remote interviews March–April.
